sloka: अन्तरिक्षे स्थितो भूत्वा पुनर्वचन मब्रवीत् ।सुग्रीव सत्त्वसम्पन्न महाबलपराक्रम ॥६-२०-२१॥।।
transliteration: antarikṣe sthito bhūtvā punarvacana mabravīt ।sugrīva sattvasampanna mahābalaparākrama ॥6-20-21॥।।

translations.english: "Oh Sugriva Who is rich in spirit and endowed with mighty prowess What should I convey to Ravana who makes the world cry?"
